title: Get the parent PID of a process
summary: Find the Process ID (PID) of the parent process that started a specific process. This is useful for understanding process relationships.

steps.explain: Use ps with the format flag to show only the parent PID (ppid) for a specific process ID.

placeholders.name: PROCESS_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the process you want to check.

steps.expect: A single number representing the parent process ID.
